title: The Period of Tola
description: After Abimelech, Tola arose to save Israel. He was the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, from the tribe of Issachar. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim and judged Israel for twenty-three years before he died and was buried in Shamir. [ref:Judg 10:1-2|Judges 10:1-2]
